subject: Request: Grandfathering promotional credits for dormant sandbox
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@quantifai.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credits expired — request to grandfather sandbox for POC completion

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well. We ran a small POC with Redwood in August/September under a time-limited promotional grant (promo code: QF-RED-TRIAL). The sandbox was auto-suspended on 2026-10-01 when the promo expired. We still have one important integration test and an eval that would let us move to a paid pilot, but re-creating everything from scratch will take weeks.

Can you help us reinstate the expired sandbox credits (approx. $5k) or otherwise grandfather the promo so we can finish evaluation? We’re a small team and this POC is blocking an internal budget decision. I’ve attached a usage report for Sep 2026 and a short note from our engineering lead about remaining test items.

If there’s any paperwork you need from our side I can get that to you today. Appreciate any flexibility — we’d like to move to a 3-month paid pilot if the reactivation proves successful.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of ML Eng, QuantifAI
marta@quantifai.ai
Attachments: quantifai-usage-report-sep2026.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@quantifai.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credits expired — request to grandfather sandbox for POC completion

Hi Marta — thanks for the context and the report. I’m sorry to hear the timing landed in the middle of your integration work.

Short answer: we can sometimes do a one-time grandfathering for expired promotional credits for active POCs, but it requires a small internal review (revenues/finance) and an ops escalation so we don’t create policy drift. I’ve looped in Jordan (account lead) and Monica (billing) to run the ask.

To expedite, can you confirm two quick things:
- Which cloud region the sandbox is in (us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1)?
- Do you have a signed SOW/PO or any procurement timeline if we were to extend credits beyond the initial goodwill?

If you don’t have a PO today I can provision a provisional safety credit for 30 days while we process approvals — pending an agreement to convert to a paid pilot or provide a PO. I’ll follow up within 24–36 hours.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Promo credits expired — request to grandfather sandbox for POC completion

Karthik / Monica — quick note on recommended approach.

Summary: QuantifAI completed the initial eval window and has a high likelihood to convert based on their usage and product fit. I recommend a one-time provisional reactivation: apply $3,000 USD in trial/sandbox credits immediately (valid 30 days) to unblock the integration tests, and offer an additional $2,000 contingent on receiving a signed PO within that 30-day window. This matches previous concessions for similar mid‑market POCs.

Rationale and ask:
- Keeps momentum without eroding policy — provisional amount < $5k.
- Forces clear procurement timeline (PO within 30 days) for additional support.
- We’ll attach a short form (escalation_form.pdf) and a terms addendum to the account that documents the concession.

If you’re good with the $3k immediate + $2k contingent path, I’ll prepare the customer email and the internal finance waiver.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: escalation_form.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Promo credits expired — request to grandfather sandbox for POC completion

Thanks for the plan. A couple of operational notes:
- Finance requires a waiver for any concession > $3,000. The $3k immediate is fine to approve at ops level, but to cover the contingent $2k we need a signed finance waiver and a forecasted ARR justification.
- Please ask the customer for a billing contact and target PO date. If they can commit to a PO within 30 days we can stage the extra $2k as contingent credit (not applied automatically).
- I’ve prepared a waiver template (finance_waiver_request.xlsx) — Jordan, can you fill the ARR/justification fields and route to revops?

Once revops signs off I’ll apply the provisional $3k top-up and attach the terms addendum.

Monica Patel
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@quantifai.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 22:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credits expired — request to grandfather sandbox for POC completion

Hi Marta — quick update and next steps.

Good news: we can proceed with a provisional reactivation today. We will apply $3,000 USD in sandbox credits to your QuantifAI account immediately; those credits will be valid for 30 days from the time they are applied. To qualify for an additional $2,000 contingent credit we’ll need a signed PO within the 30-day window and a short finance waiver (internal). Jordan will send the finance waiver for completion and I’ve copied Monica to coordinate application.

Action items for QuantifAI:
- Reply with billing contact + target PO date (e.g., 2026-11-10)
- Confirm sandbox region (if you’re unsure, we’ll assume us-west-2)
- Review and sign the attached terms addendum when you have a chance (terms-promo-reactivation.pdf)

We’ve applied the $3k provisional credit to your account (you should see it reflected in the console within the hour). This is a one-time goodwill concession to keep the POC moving — beyond that we’ll transition to a paid pilot.

If anything changes or you need more time, reply here and we’ll escalate. Looking forward to getting you back up.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: terms-promo-reactivation.pdf | DocuSign: https://docusign.redwood/tx/QF-2391
